name: api-cost
description: Collect vendor-billed API spend — Anthropic and OpenAI organization cost APIs, Gemini from a Cloud Billing export — into one dataset a dashboard reads

output_dir.title: Output directory
output_dir.description: Absolute path for costs.json, costs.csv and status.json; leave empty to use the plugin's data directory

gemini_billing_table.title: Gemini billing export table
gemini_billing_table.description: Personal Cloud Billing export table in BigQuery, as project.dataset.table; leave empty to skip Gemini

gemini_gcloud_account.title: gcloud account for the billing table
gemini_gcloud_account.description: The gcloud account bq runs as when reading the personal billing table
